children: LME aluminium (MAL3=LX) may test resistance at $3,356 a metric ton this week, as suggested by a wedge.
The upper trendline of this pattern points at a target of $3,356, the 61.8% projection level of a downtrend from $3,563. The wedge is assumed to be bullish, preceding a rally.
Key support is at $3,228, a break below which could confirm the wedge as a bearish pattern. A target of $3,149 will be established.
* The analysis is published once a week on Monday.
